result.topic_en: Scratch calculations on sums of square roots and their rationalisation, systems of quadratic relations among variables, combinatorial tables of 0/1 characteristics (theta characteristics) for half-periods, and counts of degrees and numbers of equations and unknowns depending on the genus p.
